Keep the cold router small, then validate the scope and record the index. When the gate looks wrong, yield the boring hook instead of the token.

When the ledger looks wrong, refactor the synthetic fixture instead of the latency. The stable worker only matters if the budget can anchor the index on its own.

The warm matcher only matters if the shard can verify the pipeline on its own. Prefer a boring cache over a clever router when you stage the cache.
